findings.text: correctness lens, low: Four new lines in the test pipe `/usr/bin/grep -n` into `/usr/bin/head -1` (or `cut` after it), which the SIGPIPE rule prohibits in any `.sh` file including test files; the `| head` guard (`sigpipe-antipattern-guard-test.sh` §1886) explicitly excludes `-test.sh` files, so none of these violations will be caught by CI.
